title: Functions
objectives: Declare parameters and return types explicitly
Return values via expressions, not statements

examples.name: functions.rs

exercise.prompt: Implement `fib(n)` returning the nth Fibonacci number iteratively, and print fib(0..=10).
hints: Track (a, b) = (0, 1) and advance n times.
The loop body can be `(a, b) = (b, a + b);` after binding.

options: the tail is a statement yielding ()
